page_title: UDI 1-2 SAS | Udinese v Sassuolo 15/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) earns the yellow card.
90+5' Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
90+3' M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Maria Caputi blows for a foul.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) sends a cross into the box, but Maduka Okoye comes off his line to gather the ball.
89' Sassuolo take a short corner kick.
89' The defender bravely blocks the shot from M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) inside the box. The referee points to the corner flag and Sassuolo will take a corner.
87' The resulting corner from Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
86' Here is a change. Oumar Solet is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Idrissa Gueye (Udinese).
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) will replace Domenico Berardi.
84' The corner by Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
83' Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
82' The ratio of the ball possession is 51:49.
81' Adam Buksa (Udinese) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
79' That's the end of the game for Armand Lauriente, who is replaced by Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo).
79' Kosta Runjaic has decided to substitute Jesper Karlstrom and he is replaced by Juan Arizala (Udinese).
79' It will be a substitution. Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) is ready to enter the pitch as Jurgen Ekkelenkamp walks off.
79' M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) takes a shot from inside the box and hits the right post!
78' Maria Caputi shows a yellow card to Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) for his blatant foul.
77' Corner kick. Udinese will have an opportunity.
77' The game is interrupted now, Oumar Solet (Udinese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
76' PENALTY APPEAL by Udinese, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
72' Substitution. Andrea Pinamonti makes way for M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo).
72' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Udinese due to a handball in the build-up play.
72' Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
72' The Udinese players halt their celebrations as referee Maria Caputi makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
70' Goal! Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 2:2.
70' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Udinese.
66' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is flagged for offside.
65' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Vakoun Issouf Bayo is replaced by Adam Buksa (Udinese).
65' Substitution. Oier Zarraga (Udinese) in, Lennon Miller out.
63' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
63' The ball is cleared after Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
61' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Lennon Miller (Udinese) takes it short.

58' 1 - 2 The ball hits the back of the net! Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) meets a brilliant cross from Ulisses Garcia and scores with a bullet header from close range in off the right post. Maduka Okoye had no chance of stopping that. The score is 1:2.
56' 1 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) was set free in the area by Andrea Pinamonti and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
56' The referee awards a corner and Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) goes over to take it.
55' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) commits a rough challenge and Maria Caputi blows his whistle for an infringement.
54' Flag goes up against Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
52' Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Andrea Pinamonti.
51' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
50' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Udinese.
48' Lennon Miller (Udinese) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) comes onto the pitch for Josh Doig.
46' Today's match ends for Tarik Muharemovic who will be replaced by Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo).
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

42' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
39' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
38' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
36' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
36' Arthur Atta (Udinese) sends a long ball forward to Jordan Zemura, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
31' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the roof of the net. Maduka Okoye is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
29' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) picks up a long through ball, but Maduka Okoye deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
27' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
26' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
24' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
24' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Sassuolo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
23' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 2:3.
21' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Arthur Atta (Udinese) was quite harsh and Maria Caputi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
20' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) sends a chip pass into the box, but Arijanet Muric is quickest to intercept the ball.
17' Lennon Miller (Udinese) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
16' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) has tested the patience of referee Maria Caputi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
15' The corner is swung in but Sassuolo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

13' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.

10' 1 - 0 Goal! Oumar Solet (Udinese) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Arijanet Muric had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:0.

9' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.

7' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Arijanet Muric pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
7' The resulting set piece from Udinese is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
6' Lennon Miller (Udinese) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
3' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
1' Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) is caught offside!
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Udinese will have the kick-off.
Maria Caputi is introduced as the referee for today's match.
